prompt: Which sentence says: My older brother is taller than me?
en: My older brother is taller than me.
explain: 比 comes straight before the person you compare with, and no 很 goes before the adjective.

en: He is a bit taller than me.
explain: 一点儿 after the adjective says how much more.

en: He is three years older than me.
explain: 比 + person + adjective + number.

en: Today is much colder than yesterday.
explain: 多了 after the adjective means much more.

prompt: Which sentence says: She is a bit older than me?
en: She is a bit older than me.
explain: The amount goes after the adjective.

en: Today is not as hot as yesterday.
explain: A 没有 B + adjective means A is not as ... as B.

en: I am not as tall as my older brother.
explain: 没有 replaces 比 in the negative.

prompt: Which sentence says: This one is not as big as that one?
en: This one is not as big as that one.
explain: 没有 does not go with 比.

en: He likes eating fish the most.
explain: 最 goes right before the word it describes.

en: This is my best friend.
explain: 最 + adjective means the most.

prompt: Which sentence says: She runs the fastest?
en: She runs the fastest.
explain: 最 goes before the adjective, after 得.

en: Why is it so cold today?
explain: 这么 means so, for something near.

en: This cup is so big!
explain: 这么 goes before the adjective.

en: He is not that tall.
explain: 那么 means that, for something further away.

prompt: Which sentence says: The school is so far from here!?
en: The school is so far from here!
explain: 这么 goes before the adjective.

en: The school is very close to here.
explain: A 离 B + distance.

en: My home is far from the station.
explain: 离 says the distance between two places.

en: It is close from here to the school.
explain: 从 + start + 到 + end.

zh: 我们从九点上课到十二点。
en: We have class from nine to twelve.
explain: 从 … 到 … gives a start and an end.

en: Please go left.
explain: 往 + direction goes before the verb.

en: Go forward, then go right.
explain: 往 goes before each direction.

prompt: Which sentence says: Go straight ahead?
en: Please go straight ahead.
explain: 往 comes before the verb.

en: We get to school at nine.
explain: 到 + place means arrive at.

prompt: Which sentence says: He has arrived home?
en: He has arrived home.
explain: 到 + place.

en: The children sit on the chairs.
explain: Verb + 在 + place.

en: He is already five.
We were asleep by ten.
explain: 就 means as early as.

prompt: Which sentence says: He arrived as early as seven?
en: He arrived as early as seven.
explain: 就 goes before the verb.

en: Stop watching TV, go to sleep.
explain: 别 ... 了 means stop.

zh: 因为他生病了，所以没来。
en: Because he was ill, he did not come.
explain: 因为 gives the reason and 所以 the result.

en: Because I am busy, I am not going.
explain: 因为 + reason, 所以 + result.

zh: 虽然很晚，但是我还想看书。
en: Although it is late, I still want to read.
explain: 虽然 is followed by 但是.

en: He walks in slowly.
explain: 地 turns the word before it into how the action is done.

en: The children sing happily.
explain: Adjective + 地 + verb.

prompt: Which sentence says: She smiled happily?
en: She smiled happily.
explain: 地 comes right after the describing word.

en: Mom told me to go to bed earlier.
explain: 让 + person + verb.

en: The teacher asks us to read.
explain: 让 + person + verb.

en: I drink tea every day.
explain: 每天 is followed by 都 before the verb.

en: Every student has a book.
explain: 每 ... 都 means every.

en: He often goes to that restaurant.
explain: 经常 means often.

prompt: Which sentence says: Sometimes I take a taxi?
en: Sometimes I take a taxi.
explain: 有时 comes before the verb.

en: I have been to China once.
explain: 次 counts how many times.

en: I have seen this film twice.
explain: 次 goes after the number.

prompt: Which sentence says: I have been to China once?
en: I have been to China once.
explain: Use 次 to count times, not 个.

en: There is everything here.
explain: Question word + 都 means all.

en: He does not drink anything.
explain: 什么 + 都 + 不.

prompt: Which sentence says: Everyone is here?
en: Everyone is here.
explain: 都 comes right after the question word.

en: It may be cold tomorrow.
explain: 可能 means maybe.

en: I hope you are happy.
explain: 希望 means hope.

en: I hope the weather is good tomorrow.
explain: 希望 + a whole sentence.

prompt: Which sentence says: I hope he comes?
en: I hope he comes.
explain: 希望 + person + verb.

en: He plans to go and study in China.
explain: 准备 + verb means plan to.

en: I plan to buy a new phone.
explain: 准备 + verb.

prompt: Which sentence says: She is getting ready to go home?
en: She is getting ready to go home.
explain: 准备 goes before the verb.

en: I have two teachers.
explain: 位 is a polite measure word for people.

en: This phone costs thirty thousand.
explain: 万 means ten thousand.

en: I have more than fifty books.
explain: 多 after a round number means more than.

prompt: Which sentence says: There are more than thirty people?
en: There are more than thirty people here.
explain: 多 comes after the number.

en: How big is your home?
explain: 多 + adjective asks how big, how far.

zh: 我吃饭的时候，不看手机。
en: When I eat, I do not look at my phone.
explain: 的时候 comes after the first action.

zh: 他在家的时候，常常看书。
en: When he is at home, he often reads.
explain: …的时候 sets the time of the second part.

prompt: Which sentence says: When I have time, I watch TV?
options: 我有时间的时候，看电视。
我有时间，的时候看电视。
zh: 我有时间的时候，看电视。
en: When I have time, I watch TV.
explain: 的时候 goes straight after the time part.

en: Let us take a walk.
explain: A doubled verb makes the action light.

en: Think first, then speak.
explain: A doubled verb is short and light.

prompt: Which sentence says: Let us take a walk?
en: Let us take a walk.
explain: The doubled verb stays together.
